signature.composition: red exclamation between large blue quotation marks

prompt: Create exactly one SQUARE 1:1 flat software icon on a pure white background, for an error-description message. Put one LARGE red exclamation mark in the center between two oversized dark-blue quotation marks, one opening quote on the left and one closing quote on the right. Use bold simple geometric shapes; leave wide gaps so the quotes and exclamation remain recognizable at 30x18 pixels. No circle, no triangle, no tag, no other words, no border, no shadows; generous white margin.
